# Quick Match Guide

Quick Match is the fastest way to jump into a league cricket game.

## What happens in Quick Match

- You play with your current team.
- The app picks a balanced bot opponent.
- Match length is fixed for quick gameplay.
- You earn rewards after completion.

## Opponent & difficulty

- Opponents are selected close to your team strength.
- You can use **Change Opponent** if you want a new matchup.
- The selected opponent stays saved until you start the match.

## Rewards and progress

- Winning gives better rewards than losing.
- Your quick-match stars update based on your result.
- Your team and league progress can also improve from completed matches.

## Leaderboard

- The leaderboard ranks teams by quick-match performance.
- More stars means a higher rank.
- Keep winning to climb the top positions.

## Tips for better results

1. Keep your **Playing XI** updated.
2. Use your strongest batting and bowling balance.
3. Change opponent if the matchup looks unfavorable.
4. Review your team stats and keep improving your squad.

## Good to know

- Quick Match is designed for fast play sessions.
- If you leave and come back, your selected opponent can be restored.
- Starting a new quick match clears the previous cached opponent.
